Bus Driver Attacked, Bus Stolen in Telford, England

A bus driver was attacked and his bus stolen in Telford, England. The assailant, described as a youth, reportedly assaulted the Sikh bus driver and fled with the vehicle. The stolen bus was then driven in the wrong direction, crashing into several vehicles. A Yemeni migrant has been charged in connection with the bus-jacking incident.
